intro:
Can you expose
the hidden mystery?
description:
A quiet tatami room can hide a surprisingly loud secret.

In this mystery puzzle game, you study illustrated Japanese-style scenes and tap the odd or suspicious point indicated by each question.

It looks calm at first glance, but something in the picture does not quite add up. Use your instinct, observation and the hint attached to each question to uncover traces, clues and strange details hidden in the scene.

・Read the question carefully
・Examine the illustration for anything unusual
・Tap the suspicious point in the picture
・Check the reasoning hint to understand why it matters

That little “Wait, is that the clue?” moment is the fun. Play solo, compare answers with friends, or enjoy the reactions as everyone notices different parts of the same scene.

Easy to pick up and perfect for a quick mystery break. If you like a calm Japanese atmosphere and deduction games, step into the room and see what you can uncover.
